Question: Respected sir maulna saab my name is imran . i pray namaz five times a day but from few days i faces very big problems . i am getting very bad thoughts in my minds about islam and for allah i cant express to u because i feel very shame while in namaz also i am trying to control it but i cant i feel very guilty i also do zikir of astkfar but it not help me so pls help me. Answer ID: 9029 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1154/1154=M/1429) If the bad thought come in your mind automatically without your will, then it is not bad, rather it is bad to invite such thoughts or accommodate them. While outside salah , if the bad thoughts come you should recite: أ عوذ باللہ من الشیطان الرجیم In leisure time, instead of sitting idle you should engage yourself in reciting Quran and Zikr. Also, you should keep on reciting the below duas : أ للھم أ عني علی ذکرک و شکرک و حسن عبادتک أ للھم اجعل وساوس قلبي خشیتک وذکرک واجعل ھمتي و ھواي فیما تحب و ترضی رب أعوذبک من ھمزات الشیاطین وأعوذبک رب أن یحضرون Likewise, recite Surah Al-Falaq, Surah Al-Naas and Ayatul Kursi etc and blow on your body in the morning and evening. If possible, you should get bai?ah with any pious and follower of Sunnah sheikh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
